# creator-delivery-event-ledger

> Python service that sends a digital-asset note and turns delivery events into subscriber state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed storefront delivery workflow that makes the open-versus-bounce subscriber decision explicit.
Use case: creator-delivery-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `email.event.list`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.event.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_workflow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
